test_missions: All 48 existing held-out mission texts; hidden profiles, guards, weights, labels and evaluation outcomes are never exposed to the generator or tool.
few_shot_outputs: Archived main-mission candidate policies restricted to three ordered distinct actions per archetype; development mission texts only, no structured gold context.
candidate_budget: Request exactly three distinct supported actions per archetype; primary evaluation takes first three distinct returned names, retaining unsupported names for verifier rejection. Also retain uncapped native output, counts and schema failures.
tool: One validate_policy call checks only JSON structure, six archetype keys, supported names, uniqueness and cardinality. Its feedback contains no mission gold, posterior, guard threshold, oracle or score. The second model call returns the final policy. This is a bounded ReAct-inspired compile/check/revise variant.
failure_handling: Retain every raw response and API/parse/schema failure. Two retries only for transient HTTP/timeouts; no outcome-driven regeneration. On missing/unparseable policy the candidate set is empty and the unchanged verifier's fallback/escalation logic applies.
scheduling: Fixed shuffled job order seed 2026091204; 4 concurrent workers, 1.1 seconds minimum between HTTP starts. Saved completed jobs resume without new calls.
evaluation: Original DES diagnostic, original 48 mission records, 12 source-window seeds and 160 windows per seed. Same samples for all generators. Generation replicates averaged separately from window seeds within mission.
inference: 48 mission means; 10000 paired mission bootstrap draws for intervals and 10000 paired sign-flips for two-sided tests. Nine tests: few_shot/reasoning/tool_review minus contemporaneous zero_shot on coverage/regret/invalidity, with one Holm family. Pointwise intervals. Generation spread separately reported.
reference_controls: Archived embedding, broad keyword, mission-blind and full-library references retained; contemporary prompt comparisons are not attributed to an immutable match with the older provider alias.
sequence_extension: Six additional Qwen calls: inspection/emergency x 3 repeats, eight diagnostic archetypes, at most three length-two supported action sequences per archetype. Candidate suggestions only; P6 revalidates every executed step.
